meeting.title: ZABAL Gamez builder battle finals, Space 1 (opening)

decisions.text: The three builder battle judges are Thy Revolution, Iman Afrikah and paperhandpapi. Thy Revolution judges all three tracks.
decisions.quote: our three judges which we have finalized here today we got thy revolution ... Iman Africa, our second judge ... our third judge today is going to be Paper Hand Poppy

decisions.text: The 24 hour challenge is to build on top of ZAOstock / ZAO Festivals for the 3 October event (zaostock.com/build ideas: a board, ticketing, a Decentraland stage, a WaveWarZ front end for the event). Builders pick whatever perspective they have.
decisions.quote: The goal here today is to build something on top of Zao stock or Zao festivals ... next 24 hours is gonna be all about zao stock these two builders are gonna go off on whatever perspective they have

decisions.text: Three signals decide it: the poll (already live in the thread), the three judges, and the charts on the WaveWarZ community battle created at noon. 1 percent of trade volume goes to each builder's wallet (their Solana wallet from Farcaster).
decisions.quote: three different factors ... our poll vote, which is actually already technically live ... our judges ... the third and final factor is the charts ... 1% of all those funds will be going right into their artist wallet. So their artist wallet being their builder wallet now

decisions.text: Space 2 is Sunday 30 Aug 11:00 AM ET, an hour before the battle ends; extra Spaces open whenever a builder messages Zaal.
decisions.quote: the second space, which will be tomorrow at 11 a.m. Eastern, an hour before the battle ends

decisions.text: The ZABAL Gamez finals Farcaster group chat is opened to everyone in the Space (invite link posted from the ZAO Festivals account) so all builders and judges connect on Farcaster.
decisions.quote: I'm making an invite link for the group chat we've had going for the ballgames finals. we'll open it up to anyone who's here right now

decisions.text: Thy Revolution's name for the WaveWarZ lore and content store: the WaveWarZ Abyssal Plane. Accepted on the call by the person building it.
decisions.quote: the wave wars abyssal plane kind of had a ring to it ... oh i like that i like that very nice thank you it sounds so elegant
